reading.summary: This document is the Last Will and Testament of Ruth Calloway, a resident of Tampa, Florida, signed on June 12, 2019. It names her daughter, Dana Calloway, as Personal Representative. It leaves a pecuniary gift of $2,000.00 to her niece, Aoife Calloway, and devises the residue of the estate equally to her children, Dana Calloway and Tom Calloway.

facts.label: Testator Name and Residence
facts.value: Ruth Calloway, resident of Tampa, Florida
facts.quote: I, Ruth Calloway, a resident of Tampa, Florida, being of sound mind, declare this to be my Last Will and Testament

facts.label: Personal Representative
facts.quote: I name my daughter, Dana Calloway, as Personal Representative of my estate, to serve without bond.

facts.label: Monetary Bequest
facts.value: $2,000.00 to niece Aoife Calloway of Cork, Ireland
facts.quote: I give the sum of Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00) to my niece, Aoife Calloway, of Cork, Ireland.

facts.label: Residuary Beneficiaries
facts.value: Dana Calloway and Tom Calloway (daughter and son), in equal shares
facts.quote: I give all the rest, residue and remainder of my estate, in equal shares, to my daughter, Dana Calloway, and my son, Tom Calloway.

facts.label: Execution Date
facts.quote: Signed at Tampa, Florida, on the 12th day of June, 2019

facts.label: Witnesses
facts.value: Harlan Pennick and June Abernethy, both of Tampa, Florida
facts.quote: Harlan Pennick Witness, Tampa, Florida June Abernethy Witness, Tampa, Florida
